doc.name: the-0700-brief
doc.instructions:
The 07:00 Brief, by Antevo. Your agent knows the markets by 07:00, every day: we read them so you don't have to.

A new brief every morning around 07:00 Zurich time: the headline, the market regime, what matters and why, the take, the signal to watch, upcoming catalysts and the main risks. With it: the Market Map, Big Picture, the Three Minute Brief, the Risk Radar, and notes on markets and commodities, AI and technology, energy, the energy transition and geopolitics.

Use it when someone asks what is happening in markets today, what to watch this week, or what risks are building. Earlier briefs are available by date.

Antevo's editorial commentary, not investment advice. Public, no account, no personal data.

tools.name: get_morning_brief
tools.title: Get morning brief
tools.description: The 07:00 Brief for one day: title, subtitle, hero line, market regime, what matters and why, the take, the signal being watched, upcoming catalysts, risks and what to watch, with that morning's Market Map, Big Picture and Three Minute Brief notes when they were published. Without a date it is the latest brief; with date (YYYY-MM-DD) it is the brief published that day.

tools.name: list_recent_briefs
tools.title: List recent briefs
tools.description: Recent editions of The 07:00 Brief, newest first: the date, title and hero line of each brief published in the last `days` days, today included (1 to 30, default 7).

tools.name: get_risk_radar
tools.title: Get risk radar
tools.description: The Risk Radar from The 07:00 Brief: the ranked risks being watched, each with its theme, trend, impact, probability, summary, the indicator to watch, what it would mean for portfolios, when it was first seen and on how many mornings it has appeared. The latest radar also gives when tracking began, how many mornings have been read and how many risks have been tracked. Without a date it is the latest radar; with date (YYYY-MM-DD) it is the radar published that day.

tools.name: get_sector_notes
tools.title: Get sector notes
tools.description: Sector notes from The 07:00 Brief, each with its sector, title, text and date. Five sectors: markets-commodities (Markets & Commodities), themes-ai-technology (AI & Technology), themes-energy-transition (Energy Transition), real-assets-energy (Energy) and geopolitics-core (Geopolitics). sectors narrows the set (all five by default); names outside the five are listed as unavailable. Without a date, the latest note in each sector; with date (YYYY-MM-DD), the notes published that day.
